mapper.update: update lxy_product set view_count = #{viewCount} where id = #{id}
update lxy_product set sold_time = NOW() where id = #{id}
update lxy_product set sold_time = null where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select p.id,p.name,u.username as sellerName,p.description,p.price,p.created_at as createdAt,p.img_store_path as imgPath,p.view_count as viewCount from lxy_product p join lxy_user u on p.uid=u.id where p.sold_time is null and u.username!=#{username}

select p.id,p.name,u.username as sellerName,p.description,p.price,p.created_at as createdAt,p.img_store_path as imgPath from lxy_product p join lxy_user u on p.uid=u.id where u.province=#{province} and u.city=#{city} and u.area=#{area} and p.sold_time is null

select p.id,p.name,u.username as sellerName,p.description,p.price,p.created_at as createdAt,p.img_store_path as imgPath from lxy_product p join lxy_user u on p.uid=u.id where u.school=#{school} and p.sold_time is null

SELECT p.id,p.`name`,u.username as sellerName,p.`description`,p.price,p.created_at AS createdAt,p.img_store_path as imgPath,p.view_count as viewCount FROM lxy_product p JOIN lxy_user u on p.uid=u.id where p.`name` LIKE #{query} and u.username!=#{username} and p.sold_time is null

select p.id,p.name,u.username as sellerName,p.description,p.price,p.created_at as createdAt,p.img_store_path as imgPath,p.view_count as viewCount from lxy_product p join lxy_user u on p.uid=u.id where p.id=#{id}
select id from lxy_product ORDER BY id DESC limit 0,1
select id from lxy_product where img_store_path = #{imgPath}
select p.id,p.name,p.price,p.description,p.created_at as createdAt,p.img_store_path as imgPath from lxy_product p join lxy_user u on u.id = p.uid where p.uid = #{uid} and p.sold_time is null;

SELECT u.username,m.name,m.price,m.description,m.createdAt,m.imgPath,m.`condition` AS `status`,m.soldTime FROM (SELECT o.product_id,o.sell_uid,o.buy_uid,p.uid,p.id,p.name,p.price,p.description,p.created_at AS createdAt,o.`condition`,p.sold_time as soldTime,p.img_store_path as imgPath from lxy_product p right join lxy_order o on o.product_id = p.id where o.`condition`!="订单已完成") AS m LEFT JOIN lxy_user u ON m.uid = u.id where username = #{username}

SELECT u.username,m.name,m.price,m.description,m.createdAt,m.imgPath,m.`condition` AS `status`,m.soldTime FROM (SELECT o.product_id,o.sell_uid,o.buy_uid,p.uid,p.id,p.name,p.price,p.description,p.created_at AS createdAt,o.`condition`,p.sold_time as soldTime,p.img_store_path as imgPath from lxy_product p right join lxy_order o on o.product_id = p.id where o.`condition`!="订单已完成") AS m LEFT JOIN lxy_user u ON m.buy_uid = u.id where username = #{username}

SELECT u.username,m.name,m.price,m.description,m.createdAt,m.imgPath,m.`condition` AS `status`,m.soldTime FROM (SELECT o.product_id,o.sell_uid,o.buy_uid,p.uid,p.id,p.name,p.price,p.description,p.created_at AS createdAt,o.`condition`,p.sold_time as soldTime,p.img_store_path as imgPath from lxy_product p right join lxy_order o on o.product_id = p.id where o.`condition`="订单已完成") AS m LEFT JOIN lxy_user u ON m.buy_uid = u.id where username = #{username}
